curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with constant scanning, then lane use on two-lane and multi-lane highways, speed control, and which lanes may be used for passing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for two-lane versus multi-lane lane use.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on choosing the right highway lane.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the checks before passing, what a blind spot is, staying out of blind spots and truck blind spots, how to pass and return, and what to do when you are being passed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each passing step; contrast cards for the left and right shoulder checks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the steps of a safe pass.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why keeping pace matters, the costs of speeding and of driving too slowly, checking mirrors, spotting slow vehicles, never stopping in travel lanes and avoiding panic stops.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on speed and spacing choices.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover controlled access highways, entering with the acceleration lane, yielding when merging, leaving with the deceleration lane, missed exits, and interchange layouts including the diverging diamond.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; a contrast card for acceleration versus deceleration lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on entering, leaving and missing exits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain highway hypnosis, how to prevent it, the danger of drowsy driving and the shared fix of leaving the highway.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on staying alert on long drives.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach emergency stops on the shoulder, being seen after a breakdown, reporting it, where to stop if you cannot leave the road, flares, and the signals for trouble.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each breakdown step; contrast cards for the white cloth locations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do after a breakdown.
